contexts.text: That it was indifferent to him. Signified.
From the affection in these words it is evident that they = indignation and consequent indifference.
It would (then) be indifferent whether he did evil or good.
After the wedding it is changed into a state of indifference...
Both (chastity and unchastity) are indifferent to eunuchs.
When the wives began to grieve at this utterly cold indifference of the men...
That spiritual cold in marriages is a disunion of souls and a disjunction of minds, whence come indifference...
From what is common... joys become indifferences.

The dragon... could... speak to other Spirits... indifferently, and at the same time weave deceits; but still it was heard from the indifference of his speech, in which there was something of absence...
That one should not propose to himself to do anything for certain which in itself is indifferent...
What was indifferent they made a matter of conscience... SE 3847. SE 3937.
The very indifference... he felt (at the murder he had committed) was communicated to me.
